title: Payment API timeout caused by database connection pool exhaustion
symptoms: Database connection pool reached maximum capacity
root_cause: Long-running database operations caused payment-service database connections to remain occupied, exhausting the connection pool.
evidence: Database connection timeout errors appeared in payment-service logs

title: Payment latency caused by fraud-service degradation
root_cause: The downstream fraud-service experienced increased latency and caused synchronous payment requests to wait.
evidence: Database connection pool remained within normal limits
Payment-service logs showed slow fraud-service calls

title: Payment failures after application deployment
symptoms: Payment error rate increased after deployment
root_cause: A regression in payment validation logic caused repeated application exceptions.
evidence: Error rate increased immediately after deployment
Database and fraud-service metrics remained normal
